issues.detail: The Greek 'επιβουλης' (epiboules) refers to an 'attack,' 'assault,' or 'hostility.' The Vietnamese translation 'mưu hại' (plot/harmful scheme) is slightly weaker than the active hostility implied by the Greek, but more importantly, the phrase 'sắp xuống thuyền qua Sy-ri' (about to go down/on a boat to Syria) is an interpretation of 'μελλοντι αναγεσθαι εις την συριαν'. The Greek 'αναγεσθαι' implies a movement toward or onto, but the Vietnamese adds specific imagery ('xuống thuyền' - getting on a boat) that is not in the Greek text.
